info.name: Commuter API - Complete Mobile Integration
info.description:
Complete generated reference for every Next.js API handler in this repository.

MOBILE AUTHENTICATION
The API uses an httpOnly JWT cookie. Call a login endpoint first and preserve the Set-Cookie value. Postman does this automatically; native clients must use a shared cookie jar/session configured to accept and resend cookies for the API host.

RECOMMENDED PASSENGER FLOW
Register/login -> GET vehicles and stations -> places autocomplete/details -> directions -> POST trips -> choose payments/session or payments/wallet -> poll bookings/{id}/status or payments/verify -> requests/trips history.

RECOMMENDED DRIVER FLOW
signUpDriver/login -> upload documents and PATCH auth/me -> submit-review -> availability -> assigned driver/trips -> start/complete -> wallet and withdrawals.

SECURITY
Never trust client fares, pickup times, discounts, wallet balances, or payment status. The server recomputes monetary values. Do not call Admin, Audit Logs, Internal Ride Matching, cron, or webhook requests from a production mobile app.

Generated from 122 exported route handlers. Empty optional query parameters are described but omitted from the example URL.
